summary: Tested Client Import Functionality: Template download (Excel with 3 sheets) and Import validation (RIF+Sucursal unique key, CRM contacts, detailed errors). All 13 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified all import dialog elements.

template_endpoint_returns_excel.details: Returns Excel file with Content-Type spreadsheetml and filename plantilla_clientes.xlsx

template_has_three_sheets.details: Excel has 3 sheets: Plantilla, Instrucciones, Valores Válidos

plantilla_sheet_columns.details: Plantilla sheet has all required columns: RIF, Sucursal, Nombre Jurídico, Nombre Fantasía, Segmento, Dirección, Contacto Nombre/Apellido/Teléfono/Email/Rol

plantilla_sheet_sample_data.details: Plantilla sheet contains sample data rows for reference

valores_validos_roles_and_segments.details: Valores Válidos sheet lists valid roles (Administrativo, Financiero, Técnico, Cuentas por Pagar, Operativo) and segments (Pymes, Corporativo, Mixto)

import_valid_client.details: Successfully imports valid client data from Excel file

import_validates_rif_sucursal_unique.details: Duplicate RIF+Sucursal combinations are rejected with appropriate error

import_allows_same_rif_different_sucursa.details: Same RIF with different Sucursal creates separate client records (multi-sede support)

import_validates_required_fields_rif.details: Missing RIF reports error with row number and column name

import_validates_required_fields_legal_n.details: Missing Nombre Jurídico reports error with row number

import_creates_crm_contacts.details: Imported clients have CRM contacts with first_name, last_name, phone, email, role, and contact_id

import_detailed_error_result.details: Errors include row, column, message, error_type fields for detailed reporting

full_import_flow.details: Download template → modify → import flow works end-to-end

frontend_import_dialog.details: Import dialog opens (not direct file picker) with data-testid='import-clients-dialog'

frontend_download_template_button.details: Descargar Plantilla button present and enabled with data-testid='download-client-template-btn'

frontend_file_input.details: File input present in dialog with data-testid='import-client-file-input'

frontend_execute_import_button.details: Importar button present with data-testid='execute-client-import-btn', disabled when no file selected

frontend_instructions_visible.details: Instructions visible in dialog with numbered list, mentions RIF + Sucursal as unique key

features_tested: Descargar Plantilla button present and enabled
Execute Import button present (disabled without file)

seed_data_creation: Test clients with unique RIF prefixes (J-TEST-, J-DUP-, J-MULTI-, J-CRM-, J-FLOW-, etc.) created during backend tests and cleaned up automatically
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client Import functionality fully tested and working: 1) GET /api/clients/template returns Excel with 3 sheets (Plantilla, Instrucciones, Valores Válidos); 2) POST /api/clients/import validates RIF+Sucursal as composite unique key, reports detailed errors per row; 3) Import supports CRM contacts with roles; 4) Frontend has import dialog (not direct file picker) with Descargar Plantilla button, file input, and Importar button. Template columns use Spanish names mapped via column_mapping in backend.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - All features working as expected
